crossRefs.note: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels…
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.

They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell…
For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

translations.web: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
translations.bsb: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
translations.kjv: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
translations.asv: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright; For there is a happy end to the man of peace.
